defmodule MonitorAgent do
  @moduledoc """
  A logging/monitoring agent with graceful shutdown handling.
  Supports metric names with Unicode identifiers for i18n.
  """
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @shutdown_timeout 5_000
  @max_metric_name_length 64
  @allowed_metric_pattern ~r/^[\w\.\-\/]+$/u

  defstruct [:node_id, :log_path, :metrics, :shutdown_ref, :buffer]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    node_id = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :node_id)
    log_path = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :log_path)
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)

    state = %__MODULE__{
      node_id: node_id,
      log_path: log_path,
      metrics: %{},
      buffer: [],
      shutdown_ref: nil
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  def record_metric(name, value) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:record, name, value})
  end

  def flush_metrics do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :flush)
  end

  def handle_call({:record, raw_name, value}, _from, state) do
    case validate_and_normalize_metric(raw_name) do
      {:ok, normalized_name} ->
        updated_metrics = Map.update(state.metrics, normalized_name, [value], &[value | &1])
        new_state = %{state | metrics: updated_metrics}
        {:reply, :ok, new_state}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call(:flush, _from, state) do
    case write_metrics_to_log(state) do
      :ok ->
        {:reply, :ok, %{state | metrics: %{}, buffer: []}}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  def terminate(_reason, state) do
    Logger.info("MonitorAgent shutting down, flushing #{map_size(state.metrics)} metrics")
    write_metrics_to_log(state)
    :ok
  end

  # --- Private functions ---

  defp validate_and_normalize_metric(raw_name) when is_binary(raw_name) do
    # Step 1: Unicode NFC normalization for consistent metric keys
    normalized = :unicode.characters_to_nfc_binary(raw_name)

    # Step 2: Length check BEFORE normalization expansion check
    if byte_size(normalized) > @max_metric_name_length do
      {:error, :name_too_long}
    else
      # Step 3: Validate against allowed pattern
      if Regex.match?(@allowed_metric_pattern, normalized) do
        {:ok, normalized}
      else
        {:error, :invalid_characters}
      end
    end
  end

  defp validate_and_normalize_metric(_), do: {:error, :invalid_type}

  defp write_metrics_to_log(state) do
    # Build the log file path from node_id and configured path
    safe_node_id = sanitize_path_component(state.node_id)
    full_path = build_log_path(state.log_path, safe_node_id)

    content =
      state.metrics
      |> Enum.map(fn {name, values} ->
        avg = Enum.sum(values) / max(length(values), 1)
        "#{name}=#{Float.round(avg * 1.0, 2)}"
      end)
      |> Enum.join("\n")

    File.write(full_path, content <> "\n", [:append])
  end

  defp sanitize_path_component(component) do
    # Normalize unicode in path component then validate
    normalized = :unicode.characters_to_nfc_binary(to_string(component))

    normalized
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/, "_")
    |> String.slice(0, 32)
  end

  defp build_log_path(base_path, node_component) do
    # Construct path: base_path/metrics_<node>.log
    target = Path.join(base_path, "metrics_#{node_component}.log")

    # Verify the resolved path is within base_path
    resolved = Path.expand(target)
    base_resolved = Path.expand(base_path)

    if String.starts_with?(resolved, base_resolved) do
      resolved
    else
      raise "Path traversal detected"
    end
  end
end

defmodule MonitorAgent.MetricRouter do
  @moduledoc """
  Routes metrics to appropriate handlers based on metric namespace.
  Supports hierarchical metric names like "system/cpu/load".
  """

  @doc """
  Dispatches a metric, performing namespace-based access control.
  Only metrics in allowed namespaces can be written.
  """
  def dispatch(metric_name, value, allowed_namespaces) do
    # Extract namespace (first path component)
    namespace = extract_namespace(metric_name)

    if namespace_authorized?(namespace, allowed_namespaces) do
      MonitorAgent.record_metric(metric_name, value)
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized_namespace}
    end
  end

  defp extract_namespace(metric_name) do
    # NFC normalize then extract first component
    normalized = :unicode.characters_to_nfc_binary(metric_name)

    normalized
    |> String.split("/", parts: 2)
    |> List.first()
    |> String.downcase()
  end

  defp namespace_authorized?(namespace, allowed) do
    # Check if the extracted namespace is in the allowed list
    # Uses NFC-normalized comparison
    Enum.any?(allowed, fn allowed_ns ->
      nfc_allowed = :unicode.characters_to_nfc_binary(String.downcase(allowed_ns))
      namespace == nfc_allowed
    end)
  end
end
